phase_reconstruction.method: request-row endpoint span aligned to 1-second telemetry and phases.jsonl; boundaries are descriptive, not causal timestamps

interpretation.identified_critical_path: continuous decode batching / scheduler packing across more simultaneously live sequences
ruled_down_or_not_identified: prefix reuse: disabled and zero hit/query deltas
frequency or power headroom: both arms saturate GPU at about 325 W, below 350 W limit
memory capacity: same 43869-43871 MiB peak and successful c32
prefill as gain source: c32 TTFT is slower, not faster
output histogram as usage evidence: fixed synthetic output is degenerate and excluded
interpretation.uncertainty: Aggregate telemetry cannot split MLA, MoE, and decode-kernel subcomponents within a saturated iteration; the nomination is at the vLLM scheduler/decode-batching boundary only.

nomination.mechanism: runtime continuous-decode batch packing (scheduler admission/packing policy), independent of model depth
nomination.source_bound_path: Preserve the proven max_num_seqs=32 and max_num_batched_tokens=65536 runtime path, then tune only decode admission/packing to retain the c32-style full batches without increasing the c16 latency tail.
nomination.bounded_falsifier: One matched cache-off c16 arm with the scheduler change falsifies the nomination if complete output throughput is <606.355 tok/s, peak memory exceeds 44532 MiB, or GPU utilization falls below 95% during the request interval.
nomination.quality_scope: performance attribution only; parent development quality failure remains binding
